value: The alcoholics, and not the social drinkers, had robust activation in prefrontal and limbic regions during the alcohol-beverage comparison.

After a sip of alcohol, the alcohol subjects had activation in the nucleus accumbens (bilateral), ventral tegmental area, insula (bilateral), and anterior cingulate while viewing alcohol cues compared to viewing the beverage cues; social drinkers only had slight activation in the cingulate gyrus.

value: The comparison of alcohol cues with control cues yielded activation in the anterior cingulate, right insula, and left insula in the alcoholic group.
